description: Modeled relationships within and around a subscribing organization; these are value and responsibility exchanges, not claims about PrivacyPerfect staff.

relations.name: Funds and mandates the privacy program
relations.description: Sets scope and resources while preserving the DPO’s independent advice.

relations.name: Provides processing context
relations.description: Attests to operating facts and resolves review questions.

relations.name: Returns advice and conditions
relations.description: Explains the review outcome and required action; the customer retains decision authority.

relations.name: Requests control evidence
relations.description: Asks business owners for scoped proof and verifies the resulting actions.

relations.name: Coordinates AI impacts
relations.description: Shares AI purpose and impact context for specialist privacy review.

relations.name: Shares supplier and transfer context
relations.description: Connects intended supplier uses, contracts and safeguards to processing review.

relations.name: Grants client-scoped access
relations.description: Implements client-approved, expiring adviser permissions and records revocation.

relations.name: Hands over attributable advice
relations.description: Provides scoped evidence and assumptions for the client to review.

relations.name: Funds an agreed advisory engagement
relations.description: Agrees fees and scope separately from the software subscription; modeled service economics.

relations.name: Exercises a data right
relations.description: Initiates casework through the organization’s chosen accessible routes.

relations.name: Provides an authorized response
relations.description: Communicates scope, outcome and reasons through a protected channel.

relations.name: Escalates material exposure
relations.description: Presents unresolved risks and accepted exceptions for accountable management action.

relations.name: Approves tenant scope and subscription
relations.description: Funds a bounded activation and approves module expansion after acceptance.
